trades.thesis: WCN fell 8% (2.4x volume, closed near low, WM/RSG only -1%) on a methane eruption at the Chiquita Canyon landfill (6 workers treated, LA County health order, leak capped, evacuation lifted). No earnings or guidance change; Citi sees no change to 2027-28 cash remediation costs. A single-site headline shock in a $45B diversified compounder looks over-discounted and should partially retrace.
trades.wrong_if: New regulatory, closure or liability disclosures at Chiquita Canyon, or the stock breaks below about 171 on rising volume.
